title: Concept Steering for Manipulation Detection in Persuasive Text

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if concept probes can flag manipulation in model internals, this enables real-time manipulation auditing. Directly addresses a growing safety need (election integrity, disinformation). Impact pathway is explicit and timely.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires constructing contrastive pairs of manipulative vs. ethical persuasive text, which is a non-trivial dataset curation task. Concept extraction itself is standard. Comparing to a fine-tuned classifier baseline adds work. Medium compute suffices.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple steps: curate contrastive pairs, extract manipulation vector, evaluate on held-out set, compare to classifier baseline. The dataset curation alone could consume significant time. Could be narrowed by using an existing manipulation detection dataset.
